questions.prompt: What does a `⏭` mark in `lab status` indicate?

options.a: The lab was passed on a retry attempt
options.b: The lab was forced past using `--force` (a permanent mark that never converts to `✓`)

questions.prompt: Which CLI command displays the phase map with your completion marks (`✓`)?
Why must answer file keys match exact specifications (`q1=b`, not `Q1 = b`)?

options.a: It is purely an aesthetic preference
options.b: The check script greps for exact anchored keys — extra spaces or casing typos fail the check
options.c: The CLI automatically rewrites key-value formatting
